family: BIGTREETECH Relay V1.2 mains relay module
vendor: Shenzhen Big Tree Technology Co., Ltd.
title: BIGTREETECH Relay V1.2 Operating Instruction (user manual), 8 pages

values.ref: p.2 parameters, p.3 dimensional drawing and wiring diagram, p.4-5 function description, p.8 notes
values.ac_input_note: p.2 says 85-265 VAC; note 7 on p.8 says 125-250 VAC 50-60 Hz; the on-board converter is printed 'INPUT 85-265VAC 50-60Hz, OUTPUT DC5V/3W'
values.what_it_switches: the live conductor only, between LIN and LOT (one relay, single pole as drawn). The neutral terminal feeds the module's own AC-DC converter; neutral to the load is not switched
values.own_supply: from the mains through the on-board 5 V / 3 W AC-DC module; it needs both LIN and N connected
values.contact_rating_note: not stated anywhere in the manual; no relay part number is legible

low_voltage_connectors.5V_IN / GND: short-circuit detection of the motherboard's 5 V (enabled by a jumper cap)
low_voltage_connectors.S / G (first): print-finished shutdown signal (to the board's PS-ON pin)

values.firmware_side: Marlin PSU_CONTROL with PSU_ACTIVE_HIGH true and a PS_ON pin; M81 at the end of the print switches the supply off
values.behaviour: cuts the power after printing (on the shutdown signal); cuts it at once if the motherboard's 5 V is shorted (with the jumper fitted); can be restarted with the reset pin
values.state_note: the manual does not say whether the relay is closed at power-up or what it does if the signal wire breaks

compared_with_catalogue.relay_btt_v12(): 80.32 x 36.19, holes 74.17 x 29.21: agree. Ports LIN, LOT and ctrl; contact 10 A (unverified), supply 0.5 W (unverified)
compared_with_catalogue.missing_in_catalogue: the N terminal. Without neutral the module's converter has no supply and the relay cannot operate
compared_with_catalogue.confirmed: it opens the mains live to the supply on the firmware's PS-ON signal, as the designs assume; logic 3.3 V is accepted
still_unverified: contact rating against the supply's 60 A inrush
the 0.5 W own consumption (converter is a 3 W type)
